A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same research work, with readable main text, figures, tables, equations, and Appendices A–C. All 43 pages were compared; pages 2–43 are textually and visually identical.

before.justification: v1 reports original LLaMA-7B and LLaMA-13B experiments, including benchmark accuracy, training efficiency, and sample-efficiency results in Section 6, plus qualitative outputs in Appendix C.

after.justification: v2 retains the original benchmark, training-efficiency, and sample-efficiency results in Section 6 and qualitative outputs in Appendix C.

M1.justification: The zero-initialized attention procedure, gating mechanism, and nonlinear prompt construction in Sections 3–5 are identical.

E1.justification: Both versions use Alpaca for training and ARC Easy/Challenge, HellaSwag, MMLU, and TruthfulQA for evaluation. The low-data scenarios are also unchanged.

E2.justification: Tables 1–2 retain identical comparator membership, including linear and random-initialized prompts and the LLaMA-7B full fine-tuning and LoRA baselines.

E3.justification: Section 6.1 and Appendix C retain the same model sizes, training settings, test subsets, accuracy metrics, and zero-shot versus 10-shot evaluation protocols.

E4.justification: The initialization and prompt comparisons, training-data-fraction analyses in Figures 2–3, and qualitative question-answering examples in Table 5 are unchanged.

E5.justification: Empirical reporting is identical. Neither version reports repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, or formal significance tests.

E6.justification: Tables 1–3, Figures 2–3, and Appendix C contain identical numerical results and qualitative outputs. No result entries are added, removed, or corrected.

T1.justification: The mathematical formulations, Propositions 1–2, Theorems 1–2, and Appendix A proofs and assumptions are identical, including the nonlinear activation assumptions.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about the MoE connection, optimal prompt and gating-factor estimation, and empirical benefits of nonlinear prompts and zero initialization.

C2.justification: Section 6.2 retains the same interpretations of model-capacity and sample-efficiency effects. Section 7 retains the same limitations concerning multimodal applicability, adapter and prompt configurations, and deployment interpretability and stability.

D1.justification: Training hyperparameters, hardware, parameter counts, training times, dataset statistics, and Appendix C prompt templates are unchanged. Resource-access information and embedded URL destinations also match.

R1.justification: Section 2, Appendix B, and the references are identical, preserving the same citations and positioning relative to PEFT and MoE research.

P1.justification: On the first page, affiliation 5 changes from 'VinAI Research' to 'Movian AI, Vietnam'; the date and arXiv version stamp are updated. The remaining language and document structure are unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 1–6, Tables 1–5, captions, and page layout are unchanged. Pages 2–43 render identically; the first-page edits replace metadata text within the existing layout.

improvement.justification: v2 only updates an affiliation and first-page date/version metadata. The scientific content, empirical evidence, proofs, reproducibility information, and substantive presentation remain identical, establishing no meaningful net difference in paper quality.
